title: Lanes cannot be shaded as bands or separated by a gap
foundBy: session agent of a consuming timeline page, measuring a headless Chromium render; relayed by the repository owner
details:
A timeline of several lanes per member reads as one band when the member's rows share a shade, alternating from member to member, with a gap between members. The component offers neither.

The consuming page paints a vertical gradient behind the lanes and the gutter, with a stop at each edge of each rendered label row, and inserts empty 8-pixel lanes as gaps. The gradient has to be re-measured whenever the rows change, and a lane whose height the component silently replaced misaligned every band beneath it.

A lane should be able to carry a shade token, drawn from the gutter to the end of the axis so the band is continuous through any space the page keeps before the axis, and a space before it. The selected member's band in the accent shade is the same option with another token.
